Short title and commencement

ACT XXVII OF 2017
ACT
XXVII OF 2017
SINDH
REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (REPEAL) ACT, 2017
An Act to repeal the Sindh
Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 10th August, 2017]
No. PAS/Legis-8-22/2017, dated 10.8.2017.---The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Bill,
2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 24th July, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 8th August, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to repeal the Sindh Removal from
Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Removal from Service
(Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2017.
(2) It
extends to the whole of Sindh.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

XXVII OF 2017

An Act to repeal the Sindh

No. PAS/Legis-8-22/2017, dated 10.8.2017.---The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Bill,
2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 24th July, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 8th August, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to repeal the Sindh Removal from
Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Repeal.---(1)
The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000 is hereby repealed, hereinafter referred to as the repealed
Ordinance.
(2) All
proceedings pending under the repealed Ordinance or the rules made there under
immediately before the commencement of this Act against any person whether in
government service or corporation service shall continue under the repealed
Ordinance or the rules made thereunder.
(3) Subject
to subsection (2), on the repeal of the said Ordinance, all disciplinary
matters relating to persons in government service to whom the Civil Servants
Act, 1973 and the Sindh Civil Servants (Efficiency
and Discipline) Rules, 1973, apply, shall be governed under the aforesaid Act
and the rules made thereunder and persons in
corporation service shall be governed under the law applicable to them and
rules and by-laws made thereunder.
